name: Melody Island
description: Where every voyage begins. Eight modules across two books take you from your first notes to playing songs with both hands.

name: Harmony Island
description: Chords and harmony. Learn how songs are built and start reading chord symbols like a real band pianist.

name: Notation Island
description: The basics of reading music: bars, notes, octaves and the grand staff.

name: Island of Music Fundamentals
description: Intervals, scales and chords, the maps, skills and awareness to navigate any song. Rumour has it a Jungle of Scales lies further inland.

name: Songbook Island
description: A growing library of pop, jazz, film and classical pieces to play for fun.

name: Captain's TV Themes
description: Fun theme tunes from television, arranged for young players.

name: Captain Roc's Practice Cave
description: Warm-ups, finger exercises and practice material to keep your hands in shape.

name: Exam Island
description: Preparation for the ABRSM Jazz Piano exams: scales, songs, quick studies and aural tests. Exams are optional, and always an adventure.
